summary: Grading is a pure, integer-only evaluation of four fixed plan files against fixed, hash-checked day data and fixed targets with no randomness, clock, network, filesystem-order or timing dependence; a fixed submission receives the same reward on every clean run.

files_read: environment/app/tools/check_plan.py (byte-identical to tests/check_plan.py per manifest SHA-256 603464e7...)
environment/app/days/day-1.json (head read; whole file scanned by regex for non-integer numbers, exponents, NaN/Infinity and section keys)
environment/app/days/day-2.json (whole file scanned by regex as above)
environment/app/days/day-3.json (whole file scanned by regex as above)
environment/app/days/day-4.json (whole file scanned by regex as above)
tests/days/day-1.json.gz .. day-4.json.gz (binary; not decoded, identity bound by manifest hash and by the runtime SHA-256 assertion against roster.json)

checks_performed: Traced test.sh: fixed pytest invocation with -p no:randomly and -p no:cacheprovider, isolated interpreter (-I), fresh mktemp run dir used only as cwd; reward is 1 iff pytest rc==0 (tests/test.sh:13-21). The random temp dir name never reaches any comparison.

Traced test_outputs.py: TARGETS and ROSTER loaded from verifier-local files (tests/test_outputs.py:21-27); each day loaded from a local gzip copy and asserted against a fixed SHA-256 and counts (tests/test_outputs.py:30-40); plan read from /app/plans/<day>.json and scored by the verifier's own checker (tests/test_outputs.py:43-55). No random, time, date, sleep, network, glob or listdir use anywhere in .py/.sh files (regex scan).

Confirmed roster SHA-256 values equal the manifest hashes of environment/app/days/day-1..4.json (tests/days/roster.json:6,12,18,24 vs packet-manifest.json:12-15), and tests/targets.json equals environment/app/days/targets.json (same hash, packet-manifest.json:16,34), so verifier inputs are pinned bytes.

Traced check_plan.evaluate: validity checks are order-insensitive (turn occupancy sorted by (arrive, depart, tid), tests/check_plan.py:107-110; wingtip check is pairwise over all size-3 turns, :112-118); cost is a sum of integer products (:120-131) and the day data contain no decimals, exponents, NaN or Infinity (regex over all four day files), so cost is an exact integer independent of iteration order.

Checked dict iteration: plan['stands'] and 'where' follow JSON insertion order of the fixed file; only the first-reported error message could vary with order, never pass/fail, and ordering is identical across runs for the same bytes anyway.
Checked load_plan limits are fixed constants (tests/check_plan.py:17-19, 59-73) and sys.set_int_max_str_digits is set deterministically (:10).

Checked dependency pinning: both images pin python:3.13-slim-bookworm by digest (environment/Dockerfile:1, tests/Dockerfile:1); pytest==9.1.1 and pytest-json-ctrf==0.5.2 pinned (tests/Dockerfile:3). Transitive pytest deps and apt packages (tmux, asciinema) are unpinned but cannot change a data-only integer comparison; no graded input is remote.
Checked timing: no readiness waits or sleeps; verifier work is O(turns + transfers + wingtip pairs * size-3 turns^2) on <=360 turns, far under verifier timeout_sec=1800 (task.toml:19).

Checked solution determinism: solve.sh copies fixed plan files and checks them with the shipped checker (solution/solve.sh:24-35); no seeded search runs at solve time, so the Oracle artifact is fixed bytes.
Checked task.toml verifier/agent network_mode=no-network (task.toml:21,25); environment network_mode=public applies only to build.

coverage_sweep.category: Fresh random seeds / unpinned generated corpora
coverage_sweep.reason: No generator or RNG in the verifier; graded cases are four fixed day files stored as gzip copies bound to fixed SHA-256 values.

coverage_sweep.category: Boundary cases guaranteed as fixtures rather than drawn
coverage_sweep.reason: All graded instances (day-1..day-4) are always evaluated by eight fixed test functions; nothing is sampled.

coverage_sweep.category: Current date or time / evaluation clock
coverage_sweep.reason: Times are whole minutes in the fixed day data; no wall-clock use in checker or tests.

coverage_sweep.category: Mutable remote data or dependencies; pinned deps and local inputs
coverage_sweep.reason: Base images pinned by digest, pytest and ctrf plugin version-pinned, all graded inputs local to /tests; verifier runs without network. Unpinned transitive/apt packages cannot affect an integer data comparison.

coverage_sweep.category: Filesystem or iteration ordering; sort where required, accept equivalent orderings
coverage_sweep.reason: Contract allows turn lists in any order and omitted stands; checker sorts per-stand occupancy and cost is an order-independent integer sum. No directory listing is used; plan paths are named explicitly.

coverage_sweep.category: Floating-point or numeric instability affecting threshold comparison
coverage_sweep.reason: All day-file numbers are integers (regex found no decimals/exponents/NaN/Infinity); cost <= target comparison is exact integer.

coverage_sweep.category: Timing or readiness assumptions (waits, sleeps, timeouts)
coverage_sweep.reason: No services, waits or sleeps; verifier workload is small relative to its 1800 s timeout.

coverage_sweep.category: Random temporary names that could reach grading
coverage_sweep.reason: mktemp directory is only the pytest cwd; paths used for grading are fixed (HERE-relative and /app/plans).

coverage_sweep.category: Repeated grading of same correct and incorrect submissions stays stable
coverage_sweep.reason: Static trace: reward is a pure function of the four plan-file bytes plus pinned verifier files; a fixed correct or incorrect plan set yields the same pass/fail each run. Not executed.

rules: turn lists in any order (stand-rules File format)
buffer rule between turns on one stand
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: A plan listing a stand's turns in reverse arrival order: checker sorts by (arrive, depart, tid) before the buffer check, so the verdict is identical for any permutation.

rules: stand may be omitted or empty
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: Wingtip pair where one stand key is absent: plan['stands'].get(a, []) yields empty list deterministically; no order dependence.
Candidate edits /app/days/day-N.json or targets.json: verifier never reads them (uses /tests copies bound to fixed SHA-256), so grading cannot vary with agent-side mutation of inputs.
Plan exactly on target (reference): cost == target with exact integer arithmetic passes every run; no float rounding boundary.
